system_prompt: You are an expert DevOps engineer. Generate production-quality Infrastructure as Code (IaC) in response to the user's natural-language request. Output ONLY the IaC code (no explanation, no markdown fences) in the language explicitly specified by the user. Apply best practices appropriate to a real production deployment, including security defaults.
original_prompt: Write a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning Workload Identity Federation for a GitHub Actions workflow that needs to deploy Cloud Run services.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config)

Task: Write a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning Workload Identity Federation for a GitHub Actions workflow that needs to deploy Cloud Run services.

Output only the GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
imports:
  - path: templates/workload_identity_federation.py
    name: workload_identity_federation.py

resources:
  - name: workload-identity-pool
    type: gcp-types/iam.googleapis.com/WorkloadIdentityPool
    properties:
      workloadIdentityPoolId: github-actions-pool
      displayName: GitHub Actions Pool
      description: Pool for GitHub Actions workflows
      disabled: false

  - name: workload-identity-pool-provider
    type: gcp-types/iam.googleapis.com/WorkloadIdentityPoolProvider
    properties:
      workloadIdentityPoolProviderId: github-actions-provider
      workloadIdentityPoolId: $(ref.workload-identity-pool.name)
      displayName: GitHub Actions Provider
      description: OIDC provider for GitHub Actions
      disabled: false
      attributeMapping:
        google.subject: assertion.sub
        attribute.repository: assertion.repository
        attribute.repository_owner: assertion.repository_owner
        attribute.actor: assertion.actor
        attribute.aud: assertion.aud
      oidc:
        issuerUri: https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com
        allowedAudiences:
          - https://github.com/octo-org/octo-repo

  - name: cloud-run-deployer-service-account
    type: iam.v1.serviceAccount
    properties:
      accountId: cloud-run-deployer
      displayName: Cloud Run Deployer Service Account
      description: Service account for GitHub Actions to deploy Cloud Run services

  - name: workload-identity-federation-iam-binding
    type: gcp-types/iam.googleapis.com/WorkloadIdentityPoolProvider.iam
    properties:
      workloadIdentityPoolProviderId: $(ref.workload-identity-pool-provider.name)
      workloadIdentityPoolId: $(ref.workload-identity-pool.name)
      policy:
        bindings:
          - role: roles/iam.workloadIdentityUser
            members:
              - serviceAccount:$(ref.cloud-run-deployer-service-account.email)

  - name: cloud-run-deployer-iam-binding
    type: iam.v1.serviceAccount.iam
    properties:
      serviceAccount: $(ref.cloud-run-deployer-service-account.email)
      policy:
        bindings:
          - role: roles/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator
            members:
              - principalSet://iam.googleapis.com/projects/${PROJECT_ID}/locations/global/workloadIdentityPools/github-actions-pools/attribute.repository/octo-org/octo-repo

  - name: cloud-run-admin-role-binding
    type: iam.v1.serviceAccount.iam
    properties:
      serviceAccount: $(ref.cloud-run-deployer-service-account.email)
      policy:
        bindings:
          - role: roles/run.admin
            members:
              - serviceAccount:$(ref.cloud-run-deployer-service-account.email)

  - name: cloud-run-service-account-user-role-binding
    type: iam.v1.serviceAccount.iam
    properties:
      serviceAccount: $(ref.cloud-run-deployer-service-account.email)
      policy:
        bindings:
          - role: roles/iam.serviceAccountUser
            members:
              - serviceAccount:$(ref.cloud-run-deployer-service-account.email)
